exercises.q: According to the text, what often happens to winners' relationships?
exercises.text: Many people dream about winning the lottery, but research shows that a big win doesn't always make people happier. If someone suddenly becomes rich, their friends and family often start asking for money, and relationships can become difficult. Some winners give up their jobs and then feel bored and lonely. Experts say that if you won a large amount, the best thing would be to wait a few months before making any big decisions. They also recommend talking to a financial adviser before you spend anything.

exercises.q: What happens if you return the bicycle after 8 p.m.?
exercises.text: Our hotel offers free bicycles to all guests. If you would like to borrow one, please ask at reception. Bicycles must be returned by 8 p.m. If you return a bicycle late, we will charge a fee of 10 euros. Helmets are available in all sizes. Unless you are an experienced cyclist, we recommend the flat route along the river rather than the mountain path. In case of a problem with your bicycle, please call the number on the key ring.
